invariant_text: All six distributions co-install without namespace or third-party collisions.
tool: tools/run_package_install_proof.py --format nrrd --format ora --format xliff --format ipynb --format safetensors --format ubl
result_summary: 6/6 PASS. Re-run fresh ahead of certifying nrrd (this is the fourth time this invariant has been re-confirmed fresh this session, following the ora/nrrd/ubl obligation-closure and version-migration work since Event 467): genuinely 0 failed imports across all 156 submodules of all 6 formats combined (nrrd 23, ora 14, xliff 24, ipynb 31, safetensors 21, ubl 43 -- ora's and ubl's own submodule counts grew from 13/38 to 14/43 reflecting this session's own real product growth: transaction.py for ora, migration.py plus 3 generated migratable-roots modules for ubl). See retraction below for the FF6-EVENT-000327 history.
blocker_that_previously_prevented_this_c: ora (OpenRaster) had no entry in packaging/python/package-matrix.yaml at all before this tick -- every prior compatibility-gate run (ipynb, safetensors, xliff) could only prove a 5-format co-install (nrrd+xliff+ipynb+safetensors+ubl), explicitly excluding ora and explicitly flagging this as 'a separate, pre-existing finding' in each of those gate files. Added a matrix entry for ora (format_factory.ora, load() smoke test against samples/by-format/ora/valid/minimal.ora, matching the exact schema every other format_factory.* entry already uses) -- verified with a solo `--format ora` proof (1/1 PASS) before attempting the full 6-format run.
retraction_at_FF6_EVENT_000327: The '2 pre-existing ubl findings' (ubl._build_backend needing setuptools, ubl.ubl_to_csv needing ff_csv) recorded below and repeated across ipynb/safetensors/xliff/ora/nrrd's own compatibility-gate.json files were REAL failures, but of the WRONG target: packaging/python/package-matrix.yaml's own 'ubl' entry had never been migrated to the shipped format_factory.ubl namespace (unlike its 5 siblings), so every co-install proof this whole session -- including this file's own original FF6-EVENT-000322 run -- was actually building and deep-importing ubl's deprecated legacy shim (module_import=ubl, build_mode defaulting to legacy_staging), not the real, currently-developed package. Fixed the matrix entry at FF6-EVENT-000327 (ubl's own installed-wheel-gate.json has the full story). Re-ran this exact 6-format proof with the fix: 0 failures anywhere, not 2. The 'unrelated to collision' conclusion below remains true in spirit (these were never collision failures), but the specific citation of them as 'pre-existing, expected, disclosed' findings about the SHIPPED package was inaccurate and is retracted here.
collision_check: PASS -- zero namespace collisions (every format lives under its own format_factory.{format_id} package) and zero third-party dependency version conflicts across all 6 packages' own declared dependencies (installed together into one shared site-packages without any resolver error or forced downgrade). Independently reconfirmed fresh ahead of certifying nrrd, current HEAD (45 events later than the prior FF6-EVENT-000467 confirmation): zero import failures of any kind occurred anywhere in the re-run.
note: This satisfies exactly ONE of product-goal.yaml's own multiple completion_invariants -- it is not a certification claim for any format, and it does not by itself satisfy the OTHER outstanding program-wide invariant ('every distribution extracts to an independent repository with preserved canonical source and package digests', still untouched for all six formats per this session's own Event 315 self-correction).
